supersedes_only: The earlier terminal-review wording that the semantic meaning of -654321 was not established. The original review remains unchanged as a record of what had been checked at that point.

locations: Lines 244-256 declare ADDFLAG(7,250) and equivalence (ADDFLAG(1,1), LSTW2); comments state LSTW2 determines storage length through the end of IFLG, while LSTW3 covers the end of ADDDATA.
Lines 377-387 initialize LSTW2=-654321 and pass it to NWDL to compute ILNGTH, before the later data-layout processing.

interpretation: The observed -654321 value is a storage-length marker carried through an equivalenced LNFL layout field, not a physical broadening coefficient. The six observed flag vectors containing it have all other entries zero. In the audited LBLRTM path, the extra pressure-shift branch requires sum(BRD_MOL_FLG)>0 and IBRD>0; the negative marker does not satisfy the positive-sum condition. This clarifies provenance of the marker but does not change the saved reader result or extend its physics scope.
review_scope: Source-only follow-up; no raw TAPE3 reread, model, solver, compile, or reader rerun.
